cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Make Help Define Us
cards.instruction: Get their help, then use how it is offered to redefine what the relationship means.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Help me write the complaint as a colleague, not my parent.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was only correcting your spelling.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Then leave the angry sentence. That's my contribution.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Put both our names under it, not 'on behalf of.'
